fields.quoted_span:
It is unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor thereof, to subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise
exchange anything of value in return for the services of a Service Provider.
fields.note: DX02 (Ord. 25-057) supports the core prohibition, the three-step service provider definition, the 365-day nonpublic information definition, the ban on facilitating agreements not to compete, the enforcement structure, the private right of action and the attorney fees. The 'otherwise utilize the services of' language added by Ord. 25-076 is not in DX02, so that part of the requirement is not verifiable here.

fields.quoted_span:
A first violation of § 218-12 shall be punishable as provided in Chapter 1, General Provisions, Art. I, § 1-25.
Subsequent violations shall be punished by a fine of not less than $100 and up to $2000, as provided in Chapter 1,
General Provisions, Art. I, § 1-25. Each day during which an owner is in violation of § 218-12 shall constitute a
separate violation hereunder.
fields.note: The penalty tiers and the each-day rule match. Costs, attorney fees and the private right of action are also in the text (see § 3(b) and 3(d)).
The field is empty. DX02 states no effective date. It shows only adoption on May 21 2025 and Mayor approval on May 22 2025.

fields.quoted_span:
This is to certify that the foregoing Ordinance was adopted
by the Municipal Council at its meeting on May 21 2025
fields.note: DX02 shows final adoption and Mayor approval, which is consistent with in-force status. It does not state that the ordinance is currently in force, and it says nothing about the later amendment.

fields.quoted_span:
“Real estate lessor” means any individual, corporation, partnership, association, joint-stock company, trust, or
unincorporated organization that owns real property and leases such property or any portion thereof in the form of a
residential dwelling unit.
fields.note: The definitions of residential dwelling unit and real estate lessor match the summary, including the exclusions for inpatient medical care, long-term care and detention facilities. The text contains no unit-count, size or construction-date limits.
